subject: maths
question: The average age of 30 students in a group is 18 years. When the teacher's age is included, the average age of the group increases by 1 year. What is the teacher's age (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Teacher's Age = Old Average + (Total Members × Increase in Average)

Old average = 18 years

Total new members = 30 + 1 = 31

Increase in average = 1 year

Teacher's Age = 18 + (31 × 1) = 49 years

**∴ The correct answer is 49 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 30

Average age of students = 18 years

Average age when teacher is included = 18 + 1 = 19
